title: When the Parish Turns
author: Oscar Okafor
blurb: Petra Okonkwo, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
